title: MathShow Pad Prompt Dismiss On Leave
acceptance: P1: ModePadRules.step reports an inside-to-outside transition (no cooldown); spec covers leave, blocked leave, bad input and that enter behaviour is unchanged.
P2: new server-to-client remote ModePadLeave {screen}; sender (ModePadService), Net/Remotes and receiver (ModePadController) change together.
P3: leaving a pad closes its pad-opened menu screen or toast only while that screen is still the pad-opened one; VS queue, Blitz/Skill runs and navigated-away screens are not closed.
P4: fresh-Play Studio check: walking off a pad closes its screen, standing on it opens it exactly once, a mid-VS queue is not closed; evidence with measured SHA.
P5: record-exec; check.sh and validators green; one audit; no publish, not merged.
notes: Plan approved by jg 2026-11-03 (plan from this session). Out of scope: pad geometry (TASK-0136), publishing, merging, saving MathShow.rbxl.
